therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor-associated macrophage depletion combined with mitotic disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic breast cancer, specifically triple negative breast cancer in Phase II
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum Tolerated Dose (Phase Ib) and progression-free survival at 3 months (Phase II)

results.dose_information: PLX3397: MTD 1000 mg/day oral; Eribulin: 1.4 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 8 every 21 days

context.duration: treatment until progression, follow-up average 24 months
